key_insight: CLEO fits a minimal, auditable agent harness to a fixed self-hostable LLM, achieving 83.8% held-out pass rate within 1.2 percentage points of the strongest out-of-the-box Claude Code SDK baseline.
engineering_relevance: Optimizing the harness rather than the model offers a path toward investigative agents under security, cost, and auditability constraints.
method: Keep the self-hostable LLM fixed and optimize its surrounding agent harness.
Use expert-validated data to admit only accuracy-improving tools, guardrails, memory policies, and loop components.
Require admitted components to remain general and auditable.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports an 83.8% pass rate on a held-out dataset with a harness two orders of magnitude smaller, but does not specify dataset size or the harness-size metric.
watch_item: Generalization beyond the reported investigative dataset remains unestablished in the abstract.
paper_title: Optimize the Harness, Not the Model: Fitting a Minimal Agent to a Self-Hostable LLM for Investigative Analysis
